jobs.description:
**We are Siemens**
Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer with strong expertise in modern C++, object-oriented design, algorithms, and software architecture to build and evolve scalable application frameworks and reusable software components.
  
  
In this role, you will work on the core framework layer, designing robust and reusable components that enable application teams to build high-quality products efficiently. You will solve complex technical problems involving large datasets, performance, memory usage, scalability, reliability, and cross-platform software development.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a strong software engineer who enjoys deep technical problem solving, understands how to design reusable frameworks and APIs, and is passionate about writing clean, maintainable, high-performance code.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Design and develop core frameworks: Design, develop, and evolve scalable application frameworks, reusable libraries, and common software components using modern C++.
* Build robust APIs and architecture: Design well-defined, stable APIs and interfaces, maintain backward compatibility, and apply strong object-oriented design principles, design patterns, and software architecture practices.
* Solve complex performance and scalability challenges: Design efficient algorithms and data structures and optimize performance, memory usage, scalability, and reliability when working with large datasets and demanding applications.
* Collaborate on framework capabilities: Work closely with Product and Application teams to understand requirements and translate them into robust, reusable framework capabilities that address broader product needs.
* Own quality across the development lifecycle: Contribute to requirements, design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and delivery of core framework functionality while maintaining high coding and engineering standards.
* Build automated testing and reliability: Develop and maintain unit, integration, and regression tests to validate framework stability, compatibility, and long-term reliability.
* Drive technical excellence: Investigate and resolve complex technical issues, contribute to Agile practices, promote engineering best practices, and continuously improve the quality and maintainability of the framework.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* 3+ years of professional software development experience, with strong hands-on experience developing core libraries, frameworks, platforms, or reusable software components.
* Strong expertise in modern C++ and Object-Oriented Programming, including practical application of design principles, design patterns, interfaces, abstraction, composition, and reusable software design.
* Strong understanding of algorithms and data structures, with the ability to analyze and solve complex problems involving performance, memory, scalability, and large datasets.
* Proven experience across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, software design, implementation, testing, debugging, documentation, and product delivery.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving abilities, with the ability to understand complex codebases, identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, and develop robust solutions.
* Proficiency in Python or a similar scripting language for automation and/or exposing or integrating C++ functionality, along with solid experience using Git and modern version-control practices.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience designing and maintaining public or internal APIs, including API versioning and backward compatibility.
* Experience developing cross-platform C++ frameworks or libraries.
* Strong understanding of software architecture and design patterns.
* Experience with performance profiling, memory optimization, and scalability engineering.
* Experience developing automated unit, integration, and regression testing for C++ frameworks.
* Experience with C++/Python interoperability, bindings, or exposing C++ functionality through scripting interfaces.
* Experience working in Agile/Scrum development environments and collaborating with globally distributed engineering teams.

**Why Us**
At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work - hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy. Together, 30,000 people across more than 200 countries build technology that shapes the real world. You'll grow through real projects, strong technical peers, and global mobility, backed by the scale and benefits of an industrial software leader. We're committed to equality and inclusion, and we hire based on merit, skills, and impact. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow!

jobs.description:
**About The Role**
As a Software Engineer I on the Martech Intelligence Pod, you'll be starting your engineering career working on real customer-facing applications across both frontend and backend, learning the foundations of professional software development in a supportive environment. You'll also have the opportunity to explore and learn about AI tools and AI-centric solutions that are becoming central to how we build products.
  
  
Your primary focus will be maintaining and improving the customer-facing websites we host while gradually learning about infrastructure and integration challenges the Intelligence Pod tackles. Importantly, you'll also have dedicated time to explore AI tools, experiment with LLM APIs, understand how agents work, and think about where AI can solve problems better than traditional approaches.
  
  
This is a structured onboarding role: you'll work closely with senior engineers who will mentor you through the full development lifecycle — from understanding requirements, to writing frontend components and backend services, to testing, debugging, and deploying to production. You'll start with well-scoped, low-risk tasks on both frontend and backend, and gradually take on more responsibility as you gain confidence and expertise. You'll also spend time experimenting with AI tools, building small proof-of-concepts, and learning how modern AI capabilities can be integrated into applications.
  
  
The role demands intellectual curiosity, a willingness to ask questions, and genuine interest in learning how real systems work — both traditional software and AI-powered systems. Success is measured by your growth as a full-stack engineer, the quality of code you write, your reliability, your ability to communicate what you're learning, and your engagement with exploring AI as a tool and mindset. This is a fully-supported entry point into professional full-stack software engineering at a global scale, with exposure to cutting-edge AI capabilities.
  
  
Who You Are
  
  
We're optimizing for learning potential, solid fundamentals, and genuine engagement with engineering. You don't need years of experience — you need to be curious, humble about what you don't know, and eager to grow.
  
  

* You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent bootcamp/self-taught experience with a portfolio demonstrating competency
* You are proficient in English, both written and verbal, sufficient for success in a remote and largely asynchronous work environment
* You have 0-2 years of professional software engineering experience, or are a recent graduate with solid foundational knowledge
* You have hands-on experience writing code in C# or Java (through academic projects, bootcamp, or personal projects) and understand the basics of how programs work
* You have some experience with React and TypeScript or are eager to learn them quickly — through academic projects, bootcamp, tutorials, or personal projects; you understand the basics of components and JSX
* You know the basics of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript — you understand how the browser works and can build simple web pages and interactive elements
* You understand the fundamentals of object-oriented programming: classes, objects, inheritance, and interfaces
* You can debug code in multiple environments: backend (logs, IDE debugger) and frontend (browser developer tools, console logs)
* You've written code that other people have read and reviewed — you're comfortable receiving feedback and iterating
* You know the basics of relational databases and can write simple SQL queries (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE); you're learning to think about data
* You've worked with Git and understand the basics of version control, branching, and merging
* You can debug code systematically: read error messages, add logging, trace through code, form hypotheses about what's wrong
* You're genuinely curious about how things work and you ask good questions when you don't understand something
* You're interested in and curious about AI tools (LLMs, generative AI, agents) — you've probably experimented with ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools and think about how they could be useful
* You're open to exploring AI-centric solutions to problems and willing to experiment with new approaches that leverage AI capabilities
* You can explain what you've learned in writing: you're comfortable documenting decisions, asking for help in PRs, and sharing what you discovered
* You're reliable and follow through: you finish what you start, communicate when you're blocked, and ask for help before getting stuck for too long
* You're humble about what you don't know and genuinely want to learn from more experienced engineers
* You make an effort to include others and appreciate feedback as a gift, not a criticism

What You'll Do

* Work on small, well-scoped tasks with clear acceptance criteria: bug fixes, simple feature additions, documentation improvements (both frontend and backend)
* Get hands-on with the tools and technologies we use: C#/Java backend, React/TypeScript frontend, SQL, Git, our test frameworks, our deployment processes
* Learn how our customer-facing applications work: what AEM is, how WordPress sites are structured, how they serve customers, how frontend and backend work together
* Understand the full development lifecycle: from understanding a requirement, to writing code (frontend components and backend services), to testing, to deploying to production with safety

**Frontend Development:**

* Implement small features: simple forms, content displays, UI improvements requested by stakeholders
* Learn React fundamentals: components, hooks, props, state management
* Debug frontend issues using browser developer tools: understand CSS problems, trace JavaScript execution

* Contribute to basic observability by adding error and info logging that helps the team debug issues.
* You won't be expected to triage complex production problems alone, but your logs should make it easier for others to do so.
* Keep the team's process running smoothly. That means updating Jira daily, following the

jobs.title: Software Development Engineer - Tejas
jobs.description:
Enterprises want agents that can do real work on their own data. That data sits across documents, databases and business systems that were never built for agents to read, and today's agents forget most of what they learn once a session ends.

Our team builds Sarvam's context engine to solve both problems. The knowledge side brings an enterprise's data together so agents can search it, navigate it and cite where an answer came from. The memory side lets agents remember what they learn over time, about individual users, about teams, and across the organisation. We want both to keep improving as they are used.

Knowledge and memory for agents is a rapidly evolving field. We want to build at the frontier of it, and to show with measurable results that our approach does better than traditional ones.

**About Sarvam**
----------------

Sarvam is India's leading full-stack AI company, building sovereign AI infrastructure and applications purpose-built for India. Headquartered in Bengaluru and founded by leading AI researchers, Sarvam builds foundational models for Indian languages, enterprise AI platforms, and voice-first AI agents that serve hundreds of millions of Indians. Sarvam is backed by top-tier investors and works with national and state governments, large enterprises, and developers across the country. We are building the AI layer for a billion people.

**What this role promises you**
-------------------------------

You will join a small team and own large parts of the platform. The work is driven by real customer deployments, so what you build gets used quickly and you see what works and what does not. You will also work closely with the teams building Sarvam's models, document AI and inference, which makes it much easier to solve problems that cut across the stack.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Build and run the ingestion pipeline that parses, extracts and indexes large volumes of documents, and keep it reliable when files are messy and external services fail.
* Connect to databases and enterprise systems so agents can work with structured records as well as documents.
* Design how enterprise data is modelled, including the ontology, matching the same entity across sources, and tracing every value back to where it came from.
* Build the retrieval tools agents call, with search, filters and citations, and make them fast and cheap enough for agents to use heavily.
* Build memory for agents at the level of a user, a team and the whole organisation: how it is written, stored, retrieved and kept accurate over time.
* Run evals, find where answers go wrong, and keep iterating until quality improves.
* Work with product and forward-deployed engineers to turn what one customer needs into something the platform does for every customer.
* Write design docs and keep decisions documented.

Our production stack is Go, with Temporal, OpenSearch and Postgres.

**Who you are**
---------------

We are hiring at 3 to 5 years of experience.

* You have built and run backend or data systems in production, and you have fixed them when they broke.
* You are strong in at least one backend language. Our core is in Go, so Go experience is a plus, and you should be happy to work in it every day.
* You have good fundamentals in data modelling and PostgreSQL.
* You have worked on long-running pipelines and know how to make them safe to retry and recover.
* You have worked on search or retrieval and know how to debug why the right result did not come back.
* You use AI coding tools every day and have a good sense of where they help and where they don't.
* You care about measuring quality, and you are comfortable building the evals to do it.

**Bonus points**
----------------

* Experience with knowledge graphs, ontologies, entity resolution or structured extraction.
* Experience building memory for agents or LLM applications.
* Document processing, such as OCR, layout or table extraction.
* Connectors or change data capture for ERP, CRM or other enterprise systems.

* On-prem or air-gapped deployments.
* Experience at an early- or growth-stage startup.

Spacecraft | Software | Mission Technology

About the Role

Ever wondered what happens after an operator clicks Send Command in Mission Control. This role sits right in the middle of that journey. We are looking for a recent engineering graduate or a candidate with 1-2 years of relevant experience who is excited to work at the intersection of spacecraft systems, flight software and Mission Control software.

* Bridge the gap between Mission Technology and spacecraft/flight software teams.
